name: rcf-focus
description: Maintain a live recursive center-field, drive one necessary frontier, revise obsolete closure, and preserve versions.

interface.shortDescription: Model and execute changing complex tasks
interface.longDescription: Runs inside the parent task as a structural layer: forms one current center projection, drives a necessary frontier, invalidates obsolete closure when evidence changes, preserves versions and branches, and folds or unwinds with evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Focus: maintain the live field and revise closure when evidence changes.
用 Focus：在任务过程中维护场域，并在证据变化时使旧闭合失效。
